title: Editable queued inputs and complete recovery

categories.prompt: Hold an active Chat turn at a loopback provider. Queue a follow-up, edit it from Desktop, then release the turn. Also edit an initial task waiting behind it.
Drain a durable queued Chat follow-up. Persist its transcript and accepted receipt before recording provider dispatch. Fail snapshot persistence and verify no dispatch starts.
Queue an 80,016-character human follow-up, persist its full checkpoint and shortened timeline receipt, then restore. Repeat with a truncated edited receipt.
